تتراءوا (form VI)
# تَتَرَاءَوْا (tatarāʔaw) /ta.ta.raː.ʔaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
# تُتَرَاءَوْا (tutarāʔaw) /tu.ta.raː.ʔaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
